title: 36 Hours in Cairo
abstract: Cairo is third world and first world, Islamic world and pharaonic world, a teeming city that jars all the senses, all at once.

title: 36 Hours in Napa Valley
abstract: You might need to pack an umbrella and an extra sweater, but winter is a surprisingly beautiful time to visit the Napa Valley of California.

title: 36 Hours in St. Barts
abstract: Despite a new wave of wine bars, chichi boutiques and designer restaurants, the island’s main attraction remains its luscious white sand beaches.

title: 36 Hours in Mont Tremblant, Quebec
abstract: Combining the Canadian charm of a rustic logging town with the Old World flavor of the French Alps, Tremblant is consistently ranked as one of the best resorts in the East.
